messages:
Nova: Quick heads-up — we have two visitors on Wednesday: one is a vendor (arrives 8:45am) and another is a parent visiting the team who needs accessible seating/wheelchair space. Also expecting a catering drop from Muse Catering around 11:30. Can someone confirm badge prereg and where we should stage the trays?
Front Desk Bot: @Nova — guests can pre-register here: https://redwood-internal/checkin. Accessible seating noted. Catering deliveries should go to the main lobby table; we'll tag them as 'catering — Muse' in the package log. :white_check_mark:
Samir: I can meet them at the lobby and help with the ramp. Do we have a fold-out table for trays or should it go straight into the kitchen?
Elaine: Kitchen is tight that time. Recommend staging on the small conference table by Hotdesk 3 and then move it in. I'll reserve Small Conf B for 11:15–12:15.
Jules: cc @Facilities — if anyone's doing a table swap can we get one extra trash bin and napkins? last time we ran out. :grimacing:
Front Desk Bot: Package/process note: please label incoming catering invoices as "CATERING - <vendor>" so mailroom routes them to People Ops. Any package >20lbs will be redirected to the loading dock and a notice will be left at the desk.
Mike: Lost my temporary badge last week — can someone reissue one when I bring my ID?
Nova: @Mike yes, swing by the front desk and they'll print a new temp badge. If you're expecting personal parcels, note that front desk holds standard packages for 3 business days.
Samir: Also — visitor parking? There's 2 visitor spots in lot B but they fill fast. I can grab a day pass from Facilities if needed.
Elaine: I'll send the visitor parking pass details to the vendor DM and drop a calendar note with arrival instructions (entrance C, ring intercom, give name).
Jules: tiny ask — can we get a small sign that says "Catering in this area" so people don't accidentally clear the trays? :pray:
Front Desk Bot: Noted. I will place a temporary sign and add "Catering staging" to the front desk checklist for Wed. Reminder: guests who forget ID will need to be escorted by an employee at all times.
Nova: Perfect, thanks! Everyone listed above — if you can confirm by EOD that the table + sign + parking are handled, I’ll close the loop. :thumbsup:
